Intangible Asset — Acquisition cost

The Acquisition Cost screen displays all transactions that affect the acquisition cost of an intangible asset.

This comprehensive view provides a complete transaction history for tracking how your intangible asset's value has changed over time.

Types of Transactions

The following types of transactions appear in this view:

• Initial purchase - The original cost when you first acquire the intangible asset

• Additional costs - Any subsequent expenditures that increase the asset's value or extend its useful life

• Disposal transactions - Entries recorded when the asset is sold, written off, or otherwise removed from your books

Transaction Details

Each transaction displays essential information to help you understand the changes to your asset:

• Date - When the transaction occurred

• Description - Details about the nature of the transaction

• Amount - The monetary value of the transaction

• Running balance - The cumulative acquisition cost after each transaction, helping you track the total investment in the asset at any point in time
